limits: Source-only review; no independent test rerun, actual data reread, replay or plotting performed.
Relies on the exact accepted verifier report for the original full causal/arithmetic verification; this helper derives display data rather than independently resimulating policy.
No broker fills, account PnL, guard-policy PnL or interpolated forecast path is established.
verified_scope: Pinned full accepted verifier hash and original registered20 closure; selected original files must occur in its verified inventory with exact byte count and SHA.
All three predeclared eligible episodes and original steps are retained, including absent quotes and candidate refusals; no data filling or outcome-based subset.
Decision quote and later selected virtual-execution quote preserve market, observed availability, receipt/raw hashes; midpoint uses isolated Decimal96 context.
Original node terminal expectation and target are retained as endpoint metadata, not a path forecast; original uncalibrated probability remains header context.
Arm inventory/cash comes from exact prior verified plan/settlement/state bytes; known-epoch is retained separately from price ticks.
Read, per-file/aggregate byte and path bounds are enforced; output is new exclusive external JSON only.
